# Portable Contributor Guides

When documenting team workflows, describe responsibilities and evidence independently of any specific vendor, assistant, or local tool.

## What Happened

Nutria task t36 asked for a Spanish guide about development collaborators, not runtime agents or application behavior. A first version included project-specific platform details; the revised guide now focuses on conceptual coordination, analysis, implementation, review, task boundaries, handoff, parallel work, and verification.

## Takeaway

Keep portable workflow documentation about repeatable team practices. Distinguish responsibilities from the tools a team may use, and keep project-specific runtime requirements in their own architecture or testing documents.
